page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sgn8ia-m2.xlarge is a KVM-hypervised virtual machine featuring an x86_64 architecture. It is equipped with 4 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9T34 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The system includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance integrates a dedicated graphics processing unit, featuring one NVIDIA GPU from the Ada Lovelace family with 2 GB of total VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the presence of a dedicated NVIDIA Ada Lovelace GPU alongside a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this server is designed for workloads requiring light GPU acceleration. The dedicated AMD EPYC processor cores ensure consistent compute performance without resource sharing. It is suitable for entry-level GPU tasks, lightweight machine learning inference, video transcoding, and general-purpose workloads that benefit from hardware-accelerated graphics processing.
